While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.

Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche with Shell Credits running through their veins," the Montellis take no offense-on the contrary, they wear the label with pride.

The Montelli family has a deep appreciation for all forms of art, as confirmed by Francesco Montelli, the current head of the family, and Carlotta, through their commentary on the painting Glory in Decay. They discuss how the artwork symbolizes power and change within the family. This passion is also evident in the numerous paintings displayed in their Mansion, the Montelli Quarter and Averardo Vault.

Moreover, Carlotta attends an auction where she acquires a painting titled The Banquet; in her trailer—also named The Banquet. Later, she reflects on the piece, offering her commentary on its significance.

The Carnevale in Ragunna is hosted by the Montelli Family.

The Montelli family uses codenames for family matters, with each name associated with a unique token. For instance, Carlotta’s codename is “Opal.” Two of Capollo Montelli's agents went by the names "Sage" and "Acorn". When introducing the Rover as part of her plan to uncover the family traitor, Carlotta assigns him the codename “Cat’s Eye,” referencing the "luster of Cat’s Eye gems" in his eyes. Other codenames include: Backwindow, Blue Rain, Bourbon, Clockwork, Juniper, La Llorona, Retriever & Tulip Coin.

Members: Carlotta Montelli (Second daughter of the 'lesser branch'
Executor), Zani (Averardo Bank Employee).

Main Branch: Francesco Montelli (Current head of the family), Capollo Montelli (Former heir).

Lesser Branch, Carlotta Montelli (Second Daughter, adopted into the Main Branch & Executor).

Unspecified Branch: Alberto Montelli, Ettore Montelli (Killed by Giacomo Fasciaspina).

Employees: Acorn (Capollo Agent), Benett (Former Vault Keeper), Blue Rain, Bourbon, Clockwork,Duncan (Former Employee), Juniper, La Llorona, Ludvika (Averado Vault Employee), Retriever, Roberto, Sage (Capollo Agent), Synthia (deceased), Thurber, Tulip Coin, Zani (Averado Vault Employee).

Echoes: Mercurio (Averado Bank Counter), Sentry Construct (Averardo Vault Guardian).

entries.name: Fisalia Family
entries.content:
The Fisalia Family is one of the most powerful families in Ragunna, and is enemies of the Montelli Family.
They are perceived to be "devout" believers of the Ragunnesi Sentinel, Imperator, by most.

One of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison. Their devotion to Sentinel Imperator is clear to all who know them.

A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means, shaking the family's longstanding image of dignified respectability. Yet, the head of the Fisalia family residing in Porto-Veno Castle seems disturbingly indifferent to the repercussions of these bold and provocative actions.

Members: Botim, Gilberto, Modigliani, Rosemary, Timoteo.

entries.name: Imperator
entries.content:
Imperator is the Sentinel of Ragunna, Rinascita.

The Carnevale, the grandest celebration in Ragunna, is held as a tribute to Imperator and Their deeds. It is said that Imperator will manifest at the peak of the Carnevale and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel" which grants the bearer the rare opportunity to commune with the Sentinel and receive Their wisdom.

The Sentinel of Rinascita. In the faith of the Order of the Deep, They are often depicted as a being with the upper body of a horse and the lower body of a fish.
According to Ragunna's legends, Imperator guided its settlers to this promised land, offering them sanctuary from the threat of the Lament.
Though Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the world, They maintain a connection with the people of Ragunna through the Laureate of the Carnevale, delivering divine guidance in the form of oracles.

“Our Sentinel embodies peace, justice, modesty, and mercy. They are the lord of the sky and seas, protector of the land. They freed us from division and conflict, treating all equally and uniting us as one. Legends say the Sentinel's breath becomes a gentle breeze, blessing Ragunna's ships and guiding them safely to their destinations. Their radiant gaze pierces the darkness, illuminating the way forward. In reverence, people built lighthouses across the island. The Sentinel never boasts of Their deeds but bestows miracles in subtle ways, as it is written. ‘I am the gentle breeze that caresses you in green meadows. I am the unseen guardian as you walk in the valley of shadows. I am with you, steadfast and unwavering, from the past, through the present, and beyond the future’.”

entries.name: Overclock
entries.content:
By consulting the waveform graph and its time frequency fluctuations, scientists are also able to predict the risk of the of a resonator.

When a Resonator’s mental capacity is overwhelmed, they may lose control of their Forte, causing an overflow of Resonance energy. Scientists have established a comprehensive Overclock diagnosis process to accurately predict potential risks of Overclocking.

An example with Yangyang: "During the event, Resonator Yangyang experienced emotional overflow and temporary loss of Forte control. Fortunately, there were no casualties or hazards reported, though she suffered several comatose episodes due to the overstimulation. Further examination revealed that Yangyang's heightened perception was causing harm to her body through her Forte. The aftereffects have since stabilized, but the feather-like transformation on the ends of her hair remains irreversible."

entries.name: Common Echo
entries.content:
In Rinascita, most Echoes can exist independently from Reserved Terminals within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. They are known as Common Echoes.
In Ragunna, the Order of the Deep governs the allocation and use of these Echoes. The people of Ragunna revere them as divine gifts, even as envoys of Sentinel Imperator. They treat them as friends and trusted allies, incorporating them into every aspect of daily life. This deep, symbiotic bond with Common Echoes is what has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."

entries.name: Genesis Nexus
entries.content:
Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty.

Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.

entries.name: Dark Tide
entries.content:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field.

There have been two significant Dark Tides in Ragunna's history. The first, according to the Order of the Deep, was stopped by Napoli II, the first Primus of the Order. The second was quelled by the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys.

entries.name: Thorncrown Rises
entries.content:
Thorncrown Rises is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

At the edge of the cliffs of the Thessaleo Fells, three isolated towers stand tall, their sharp, thorn-like spires resembling crowns of sin and guilt. It is said that the fate of the Fisalia family's descendants is deeply intertwined with these three towers.

entries.name: Resonance Nexus
entries.content: The nexus of an ecological information network designed based on the principles of Wutherium Science. Typically situated in medium and large towns, it detects and models energy fluctuations, activities of Tacet Discords, and other abnormal signals to provide early warnings of Waveworn Phenomena.

entries.name: Troupe of Fools
entries.content:
The Troupe of Fools, or the Fool's Troupe, is a carnevale-themed troupe based in Rinascita. They perform on tour across all of Rinascita, travelling on the back of Lario, with their hidden refuge being located deep in a vast underground cavern on Penitent's End island.
From every corner of the Rinascita Archipelago, playwrights and performers gather, praising the Troupe's art to be like "dancing in chains," defying the weight of conformity with their performance.

The Fools who survived the dragon's assault-whom the Order refers to as the "pilgrims"—drifted on the warm currents, eventually finding refuge in a vast cavern on Penitent's End.

There, the Fools formed a troupe, determined to one day expose the truth hidden by the Order and return to their home. To achieve this, the troupe wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

For years, they have awaited the return of the Carnevale, hoping to expose the Order's secrets through their performance, claim the Laurel, and earn the chance to commune with the Sentinel.

As the Primus of the Order of the Deep, Fenrico has used the Pilgrim's Sail as a way to banish those he sees as a threat to the Order's goal of achieving unity. Anyone who disobeys or questions the Order and its doctrine are branded 'Fools', and forced to board a ship to Penitent's End, once a sacred spot for pilgrims before being corrupted by the Dark Tide. Although Fools are told they can find redemption and a place beside the Sentinel through this voyage, they are instead subject to the dangers of the Remnant Clouds, a mist that traps Reverberations that turn into Tacet Discord, and the Dragon of Dirge, whom has been altered by the Order with the help of the Fractsidus to attack all living creatures on sight.

As a young boy, Brant curiously questioned the appearance of the Sentinel's statue inside the Cathedral of Mercury, and was immediately branded a Fool and sent on the Pilgrim's Sail. While the other Fools on his ship did their best to shield the child from the reality of their fate, he ultimately watched them die one by one. However, they were able to fight against the Tacet Discord and scavenge enough from their shipwreck to build Fool's Elysium, thus beginning the Troupe of Fools.

In addition to establishing a refuge for themselves and patrolling the coast of Penitent's End island in search of new survivors, they have dedicated themselves to performing as they await the return of the Carnevale. There, they hope to expose the Order's lies through a grand performance, and claim the Laurel for the chance to commune with the Sentinel.

During What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing, the Troupe of Fools fulfill their goal by performing at the Carnevale with Rover, who claims the Laurel. Following the festival, Fenrico grants the troupe permanent rights within Ragunna.

Members: Brant (Captain), Roccia (First Mate), Barton, Dionysia, Dominick, Mosi.

Echoes: Lario.

entries.name: Hallowed Reach
entries.content:
Hallowed Reach is a Region located in Rinascita.

Echoes from Ragunna's Past I: 

These are the lyrics from the final scene of an ancient opera, preserved by the Order. It is said that no one remembers its melody:

O sea of clouds!
Cease your workings!
The faint shimmer beneath the water,
It's the trace of my beloved!
Let the endless sea
Take me and my homeland away!
The eternal, unsettling dream!
It descended upon me!
O mighty Imperator!
After a life of sorrow,
Might I finally find the peace I've prayed for?
But no! It's only an empty longing!
Peace never comes through a Divine Envoy!

Echoes from Ragunna's Past II:

These are the lyrics from the final scene of an ancient opera, preserved by the Order. It is said that no one remembers its melody:

Salvation fades, lost forever!
Our home will eternally sleep beneath the waves!
Onward to the sea! Onward to the sea!
Sail onward, forever upon the waves!
Raise the sail! Weigh the anchor!
Bid farewell to old Ragunna!

entries.name: Garden of the Lost
entries.content:
Garden of the Lost is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

The ownerless echoes discovered a peculiar Echo painting, capable of unfolding a Sonoro Sphere through Sonance Caskets, stabilizing the echoes so they neither dissipate nor act erratically. As a result, more ownerless echoes gradually gathered here and built the Puppet Village.

entries.name: Twin Peaks
entries.content:
Twin Peaks is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

A deep gorge winding and tearing through the land, where wandering Aetherfins, seemingly carried by the gentle breeze, swim toward the direction of Porto-Veno Castle.

entries.name: Resounding Rise
entries.content:
Resounding Rise is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

Within this tower, terrifying echoes wander, their forms born from the bodies of those long departed. These resounds remain eternally frozen in time, preserving life and death in an endless stasis.Perhaps the forgotten tales of the Fisalia family are hidden within its shadowed halls as well.

entries.name: Twilight Rise
entries.content:
Twilight Rise is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

A suffocating corridor bathed in dim light beckons those who wander within. Mystical echoes guide the unknowing deeper into the tower's depths, through endless passageways where they lose themselves forever, never again to glimpse the daylight outside.

In the twilight, all things return home. Yet your intuition warns you of an unspeakable presence waiting patiently...
It waits for the boat to dock, for the people to arrive, for the sun to descend—waiting for all to return to their comforting homeland. Once this world without light falls into silence, it will emerge, invade the night, and devour everything.

entries.name: Command Rise
entries.content:
Command Rise is an area of Thessaleo Fells, Rinascita.

The largest of the three towers, the Command Rise is veiled in mystery, its interior filled with mechanisms and puzzles leading to the pinnacle. At the summit, within a pitch-black chamber, lies an enormous laurel—a possible key to uncovering the secrets of the Thorncrown Rises and the Fisalia Family. Head into the tower... the Fisalia descendants leaves only his silhouette behind—he is destined to fulfill his mission.

entries.name: Oakheart Highcourt
entries.content:
Oakheart Highcourt is an area of Fagaceae Peninsula, Rinascita.

A massive courtyard of unknown origin stands here, with a colossal oak tree at its center. The tree’s thick roots
stretch down along the courtyard walls, while its lush leaves shimmer with golden light under the sun.

The Central Pavilion: At the heart of the courtyard lies a mysterious pavilion, which houses an enormous simulation chessboard.

"The Lifer": An echo, for reasons unknown, is confined here. It endlessly mutters repetitive phrases and invites every visitor to play a game of chess with it.

Simulation Chessboard: Sitting in the chair opposite "The Lifer" activates the chessboard, where enormous black and white chess pieces appear. These chess pieces are actually made up of various shapes of echoes. The design of these pieces may be connected to whoever built this courtyard.

Outer Maze: The central chessboard in the pavilion controls the switches for other rooms outside the pavilion. These rooms encircle the chessboard, forming a labyrinth.

entries.name: Shores of last Breath
entries.content:
Shores of Last Breath is an area of Fagaceae Peninsula, Rinascita.

A group of small islands perpetually shrouded by storms, rendering entry nearly impossible. The Order of the Deep asserts that these storms are trials of faith, claiming that only the most devout believers can cross the Shores of last Breath and bear witness to the divine oracle engraved within the Northern Sacred Forest.

Sighing Storm: The sea breeze from Penitent's End, carrying strong air currents , gathered above this coastline.

Over time, this has resulted in the formation of a terrifying and persistent weather phenomenon along the coast.

entries.name: Oak Monolith Forest
entries.content:
An an area of Fagaceae Peninsula, Rinascita.

On the journey across the Shores of Last Breathe, stone monoliths are scattered along the path, while monsters perch in the skies above. This perilous area, ravaged by storms, resembles the arduous trials described in the doctrines of penance.

At the northernmost point of the Shores of Last Breathe lies the Sanctuary, said in legends to be the closest altar to the Sentinel. Over countless years, the inscriptions on the stone tablets have long been mottled and unclear. The treacherous conditions of this site have deterred most believers from venturing here to pay homage.

In the past, former priest of the Order of the Deep relocated some of the sanctuary's monoliths to various points across the Shores of Last Breathe, carving and erecting smaller sanctuaries to make them more accessible for worship.

entries.name: Coast of Anticipation
entries.content:
An an area of Fagaceae Peninsula, Rinascita.

The Fagaceae Peninsula boasts an extensive coastline, and the sea near this coastline is referred to by the people of Ragunna as the Coast of Anticipation.

entries.name: Wailing Ascent
entries.content:
Wailing Ascent is an area of Penitent's End, Rinascita.

The long bridge leading to Penitent's End was once the only road from Ragunna to the island, but the bridge has
long since collapsed, rendering it impassable.

entries.name: Shipwreck Shore
entries.content:
An area of Penitent's End, Rinascita.

The wreckage of ships that encountered storms or ran aground will drift to Shipwreck Shore with the ocean currents, and even intact Pilgrim Sail may run aground there. After the “Black Tide” outbreak in Rinascita, numerous echoes were left on Penitent's End. Coupled with the spreading "Remnant Clouds" from the Sea of Clouds, countless TDs are drawn to this place, where sorrowful whispers echo day and night.

entries.name: The Strand
entries.content:
The Strand is an area of Penitent's End, Rinascita.

The Strand is where many ships have wrecked and are inhabited by various dangerous TDs.
Whenever the sea fog spreads, the "contaminated remnant energy" within the fog can destabilize the frequency
of resonators.
Occasionally, various illusions appear within the fog, some of which are "mixed" with remnants of frequencies left
by the departed.

entries.name: Pilgrim Path
entries.content:
An area of Penitent's End, Rinascita.

The Pilgrim Path is the only route leading to the highest point of Penitent's End.
The distant, winding staircase ascends continuously, with dim candlelight burning on both sides. Numerous TDs
lurk along this path, indiscriminately attacking anyone who attempts to climb the stairs in search of repentance.

entries.name: White Mist Dam + Cloud Sea Dock
entries.content:
An area in Nimbus Sanctum, Rinascita.

The White Mist Dam is located at the edge of the Nimbus Sanctum, and from here, one can take a gondola into the sea of clouds.

According to legends in Ragunna, the center of the Nimbus Sanctum holds a tranquil, mirror-like body of water. It is said to purify the dark thoughts of people, transforming them into part of the mist. Some believers travel here on pilgrimages, hoping to attain peace of mind through this purification process.

Cloud Sea Dock: The Cloud Sea was once a crucial and perilous route connecting the Averardo Bank in Ragunna City with the Averardo Vault. The Montelli family established multiple gondola stations in the sea of clouds.

In recent years, strange phenomena have been occurring frequently within the mist, causing the gondola stations to suspend services for travelers.
entries.comment: White Mist Dam + Cloud Sea Dock

entries.name: Nimbus Sanctum Ruins
entries.content: There are many ancient architectural ruins scattered throughout the sea of clouds. Among the collapsed walls, numerous stone tablets are found, most of which contain inscriptions related to Ragunna's past.

entries.name: Cloud Puffer Express
entries.content:
The echo express, operated by the Averardo Vault, transports valuable items that people wish to store, moving them from the main city's bank to the vault's underground facilities.

The docks in the sea of clouds now serve as temporary resting points for the Cloud Puffer Express, acting as stopping stations during its journey.

entries.name: Song of Night Garden
entries.content:
An area in Nimbus Sanctum, Rinascita.

Song of Night Garden: The Song of Night Garden is located in the heart of the sea of clouds, where the mist dissipates. At its center, there is a circular body of water, its surface as clear as a mirror.

Cloud Court Garden: By day, the garden is peaceful and serene, resembling a heavenly retreat amidst the clouds. However, by night, a constellation of stars twinkles above, reflecting upon the shimmering surface of the water, creating a mesmerizing spectacle.

entries.name: Golden Harbor
entries.content:
The Golden Harbor is a natural sea port that borders the Nimbus Sanctum and the Averardo Vault, with a waterfall acting as a barrier.

By riding a gondola, one can leap over the waterfall and quickly reach the Averardo Vault.

entries.name: Sanctuary of Remembrance
entries.content:
An area in Nimbus Sanctum, Rinascita.

The Sanctuary of Remembrance was once part of the Order of the Deep. The past calamities of Ragunna turned this place into ruins. Today, remnants of monstrous figures occupy the site, making it a forbidden zone strictly prohibited by the Order.

The remnants of ancient buildings and stone tablets scattered throughout the area hold stories about the Sentinel and the founding of the Order by Primus.

entries.name: Silent Wind Grocery
entries.content:
An area in Whisperwind Haven, Rinascita.

A small and inconspicuous grocery store tucked in a corner of the town, Silent Wind Grocery is owned by Vita, who was once a well-known traveling merchant before settling in the town.

The store offers some rare goods that are not commonly found in the market. These items are only brought out for specific customers when they arrive.

entries.name: Egla Town Legends
entries.content:
Unyielding Courage: In the town square of Egla, there stands a giant stone sword, which the townspeople call the "Knight's Proof".

According to local legend, a brave knight once journeyed deep into the Whisperwind Haven, slaying dangers and protecting the weak without seeking anything in return.

"I will remember humility, justice, and bravery... never wielding power over women, children, or the unarmed, standing against injustice and unfairness..." The knight followed his principles and eventually defeated the terrifying "giant".

Knight of the Night Bridge: In the town's legend, the brave knight began his journey from Knight of the Night Bridge.

People who followed the legend to the town have left behind more tales of knights.

Mad Knight: Egla Town has always been famous for its knight legends, with one tale, that of the "Mad Knight", being particularly widespread and contributing to the town's unique atmosphere.

It is said that the "Mad Knight" was originally a human who, after lurking in the night to slay the monsters threatening the town, was ultimately infected by one of them. He transformed into a creature that now roams the night.

As a result, the residents of Egla Town return to their homes at night, letting their echoes accompany the now-mad knight to perform a "Knight's Fantasy Play", soothing the obsession that still lingers in him. This is why, during the night, the townspeople stay indoors while the echoes freely roam the streets.

Through relevant literature research and field exploration, we hypothesize that this knight was likely a Resonator. The monsters he fought were probably Tacet Discords attracted to the town by human activity, and his descent into madness was a result of excessive use of his resonance ability, leading to overclocking.

The townspeople have passed down his story through generations, and those with the same ideals are drawn to the town. Today, the knight remains an irreplaceable symbol of the village.

"Do not be alarmed by the strange sounds outside; they are merely performances dedicated to honoring the knights of old."

entries.name: One-Eyed Windmill
entries.content:
An area in Whisperwind Haven, Rinascita.

**One-Eyed Windmill**

Once known as Whisperwind Cliffside, the land was dry and lacked water sources, with exposed rocks scattered across the terrain.

To overcome this, windmills were established at high altitudes near the sea of clouds, redirecting water from lower regions to irrigate the land. After many years of cultivation, the landscape gradually transformed into its present form.

However, as the landscape changed, it not only attracted humans and echoes, but also some dangerous Tacet Discords—one of which is a terrifying entity known as the "Giant". It awakens at night and attacks any living creature it encounters.

As a result, both humans and echoes were forced to evacuate, establishing a new settlement downstream, known as Egla Town.

entries.name: Illusive White Moon Forest
entries.content:
An area in Whisperwind Haven, Rinascita.

A solitary figure stands on a small island in the sea, surrounded by a circular forest that encircles the central lake.

Beside the lake lies a collapsed ruin, where, among the scattered remnants, one can see empty sword slots. These slots appear to bear engravings related to the legend of knights. What might happen if the lost knight's sword were returned to its rightful place?

entries.name: Mirrored Lake
entries.content:
An area in Whisperwind Haven, Rinascita.

At the center of the circular forest lies a round lake that mirrors its surroundings.

It is said that the lake reflects "another self," and this "other self" becomes the final adversary in the trial...

entries.name: Elevator Launch Tower
entries.content:
An area near Averardo Vault, Rinascita.

The sole passage connecting the Vault Management Area to the Underground Storage Area beneath the clouds.

The dense and mysterious Etheric Sea acts as a natural barrier between the surface and the underground.

Using the launch tower's power, the elevator penetrates the layered sea of clouds, reaching the subterranean Vault Storage Area.

entries.name: Vault Management Area - Office Hall
entries.content:
The main workspace for the employees of the Averardo Vault, where efficiency is paramount, operating like a precisely tuned machine. Staff work diligently to coordinate and manage the storage and retrieval of various items.

The Averardo Vault offers secure transportation services tailored to clients' specific needs, creating custom logistics plans to ensure the safety and undamaged delivery of valuables into the vault.

If clients wish to transfer ownership of their valuables, the vault's certified appraisers assess the items' worth, enabling the vault to purchase them based on their appraised value.

entries.name: Ducat Auction Hall
entries.content:
The Averardo Vault regularly hosts auctions in the Ducat Auction Hall, adhering to the principles of "openness, fairness, impartiality, and highest bid wins." Any legally acquired and appraised items may be entrusted to the vault's auctioneers for sale.

Buyers or sellers unable to attend in person can utilize terminal delegation to have the vault staff conduct purchases or sales on their behalf.

The obsolete Ragunna currency, Monanie is used as the bidding token. The exact exchange rate of a single Monanie to Shell Credits is known only to the attending bidders.

entries.name: Montelli District
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

The most artistically vibrant district in Ragunna City, where art salons, private theatres, and poetry societies converge.

Led by the Montelli family, the new aristocracy resides here, critique art pieces and exchange business information

entries.name: Pioneer Association Ragunna Division
entries.content:
The Pioneer Association is highly active in the Ragunna region with its "Tidal Imagery" projects. Leveraging holographic photography technology, the Association records and archives various forms of theatre. The "Tidal Imagery" production team also publishes a sub-journal titled Theatrical Reviews.

To facilitate better collaboration, the Pioneer Association has set up a dedicated studio in Ragunna City.

Felinn, the curator of the "Tidal Imagery Studio," also serves as a documentary director specializing in theatrical arts. Known for his humour and professional insight into theatre, Felinn faithfully captures the theatrical art of Rinascita in visual form. His works also document countless moments of harmony between humans and echo remains.

His best partner is a camera echo remains named C-moss, and the two are inseparable.

entries.name: Sarloto Open-Air Gallery
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

A semi-open gallery showcasing the famous paintings collected by the Montelli family. Along the gallery, there are art salons where members of the Montelli family often gather to critique artworks and exchange business information.

entries.name: Portrait of the Gladiator
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

Hanging on the wall like any other painting, this particular portrait is actually a resonance relic painting. The gladiator depicted within emerges partially from the canvas, striking an aggressive pose toward passersby. Engaging in conversation with it might allow entry into the painting for a trial—an intense duel awaits.

entries.name: Tidal Chapel
entries.content:
An area near the order of the deap, rinascita.

A floating chapel connected to the inner sea of Ragunna City, housing a towering statue of the Sentinel.

Believers of the Order travel by gondola to worship, leaving flowers and water lanterns upon the surface.

The water level within the chapel rises and falls with the tides, symbolizing the Sentinel's breath giving life to the ebb and flow. Hence, it is called the Tidal Chapel.

entries.name: Fisalia Mansion District
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

The residential area where members of the Fisalia family gather and live daily.

Connected to the Order, it resembles a vast aerial garden, with the streets adorned by numerous sculptures from the Order of the Deep.

entries.name: The Order's Tower
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

The tower where the clerics of the Order of the Deep carry out their duties.

On either side of the interior stand enormous sculptures, resembling silent guards watching over every visitor.

entries.name: The Order's Garden
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

Behind the Mercury Celestial Church of the Heavenly Saint lies a small water garden. At the end of the garden, in the Confession Room, there seems to be a hidden secret.

entries.name: Plaza District
entries.content: A large square connecting Ragunna City's Bank Street with the Montelli District, it is a necessary passage for Ragunna residents in their daily routines. Both tourists and locals pass through or linger here, creating a lively and bustling atmosphere.

entries.name: Freedom Square
entries.content:
Located in the heart of Ragunna City, this giant square is referred to by the locals as "Freedom Square."

Local theater troupes and performers treat the square as an impromptu stage, and street artists often intuitively cooperate with these "sudden" performances, harmonizing with music or even joining in with impromptu acts.

entries.name: Aritho Sacred Well
entries.content:
An area within Ragunna, Rinascita.

In the center of a small square in front of Freedom ****Square stands a statue of the "Sentinel" with a fish-tail surrounding a freshwater well named the "Aritho Sacred Well."

A legend is passed down in Ragunna City: after tossing an old, outdated coin from Ragunna, called "Mone", into the well, one can ask the statue questions, divine good or bad fortune, or verify the truth of matters. Those who approach with sincere devotion will receive a response.

**Aritho Sacred Well Water Divination Tips:**

1. Those who sincerely seek knowledge can take a "Mone" coin and toss it into the well, while silently praying to the Sentinel. Those who are truly devoted will receive a response, and they should remain observant.
2. Visitors and residents are prohibited from entering the well or retrieving the "Mone" coins from the water, as it is a great disrespect to the Sentinel. Those who show disrespect will be subjected to terrible punishment by the Sentinel.

entries.name: Odyssey Opera House
entries.content:
The most renowned water opera house in Ragunna, located where the waves crash against the shore.

When the waves strike the back of the opera house, they create splashes, making "every opera feel like an Odyssey," which is how the name came about.

entries.name: Hotel "Agrotta Palace"
entries.content: Located in the commercial district, Agrotta Palace is often the first choice for visitors coming to Ragunna. As one of the businesses run by the Montelli family, Agrotta Palace is a luxury hotel in Ragunna City. Its prime location greatly facilitates the travel of tourists, and its first-floor Margret Family Restaurant is one of the most popular dining spots in Ragunna City.

entries.name: Gondola Grocery
entries.content:
Ragunna City is situated on the surface of the water, with an intricate network of waterways both inside and outside the city. Due to the limitations in the city’s original construction scale, the streets of Ragunna are relatively narrow, and the land outside is rugged and uneven.

As a result, the gondola, a boat-shaped echo, has become the best choice for travel and transporting goods.

entries.name: Error Cell
entries.content:
Within Tethys’ Deep.

The Stellar Matrices’ orbital dance represents the execution of complex, high-dimensional code. As these celestial bodies collide, merge, and collapse, the code evolves through countless iterations. Occasionally, this process spawns errant codes within some Stellar Matrices. To avoid contamination, the Black Shores contains these Stellar Matrices in special Tacetite vessels.

The Error Cell then analyzes the aberrant data, deploying specialized probes to isolate the rogue code segments.

entries.name: KU-Roro Charging Station
entries.content: Nestled in Tethys’ Deep, KU-Roro Charging Station is where KU-Roros (aka Tethys Terminals) return to recharge and “rest” when their energy reserves run low.

entries.name: Modulation Hall
entries.content:
Within Black Shore's Underground.

The lighthouse of the subterranean galaxy and the heart of human activity in the Black Shores. It is where [the] “Modulator” of the past and people of the present observe and guide the course of stars in the vast underground sky.

Through here all beings are reborn as stars, which, in turn, reflect brief moments of reality. With the power of the Tethys System, Star Matrices brought to this place can reveal glimpses of the past, whether of destruction or renewal.

entries.name: Data Torrent
entries.content:
The Data Torrent connecting all the Nexus on this planet continuously transfers information about abnormal fluctuations caused by the Lament and Waveworn back to the Stellar Matrix. The Stellar Matrix then constructs  models to predict thelocation and time of the next Lament. 

However, it must be noted that the raw energy of the Data Torrent is capable of annihilating  any physical entity caught in its flow.

entries.name: Tethys’ Space Anchors
entries.content:
These stabilizing devices are strategically positioned throughout the surface and underground parts of the Black Shores. Their primary function is to calibrate and stabilize the frequencies of the giant Tacetite that makes up the island, effectively isolating the Tethys System’s virtual layer from reality. Additionally, these Anchors facilitate communication and carry the responsibility of observing the Etheric Sea, eliminating the need to build a Nexus Tower in the Black Shores.

The Anchors drew inspiration from the reactor control rods used in pre-Lament reactor engineering. They are considered exemplary models of the Black Shores’ minimalist engineering design.

entries.name: Veiled Rock
entries.content:
An area on the Black Shores' surface.

Amidst the lingering mist and blake blooms, this is where newcomers first set foot upon their arrival.

entries.name: Hall of Foreign Affairs
entries.content: The grand hall of the Black Shores where foreign envoys are received. It also functions as the administrative hub that manages the region’s affairs..

entries.name: KU-Money Exchange
entries.content: KU-Money is a robotic overseer or personnel costs in the Black Shores, ensuring every team member receives the necessary funds for their missions. Passionate about cost-efficiency, KU-Money often engages in economic transactions and offers supply for purchase whenever needed.

entries.name: Black Shores Greenhouse
entries.content:
The glass conservatory perched at the highest point of the Black shores. An impressive collection of plant specimens from across the world thrives within its walls. Every newcomer, Bloom Bearer or Consultant, is invited to contribute a seed from their homeland. At the heart of this verdant sanctuary, a unique modulation device sits encircled by flowers representing diverse civilizations.

Each plant in the Greenhouse speaks the unspoken hopes of its sower. Some of these seeds come from lands erased by the Lament, standing as the last living memory of places that no longer exist.

entries.name: Haven of Sprouts
entries.content: To make things easier for the staff, the Black Shores has installed access doors for quick travel between locations. But among the staff, a tale about a mysterious door emerges. It is said that passing through the doors in a specific way will lead you to a hidden room filled with rare treasures. Yet some claim that those who enter the room will never find their way back. To this day, the truth remains a mystery.

entries.name: Eye of Asteria
entries.content: The eye through which the Black Shores gazes upon the stars. It monitors the Etheric Sea of Solaris from the Black Shore’s highest Vantage point.

entries.name: TD Observatory
entries.content: The TD Observatory is where Black Shores stores TD data gathered from around the world. The data will then be converted into digital Reverberations and transferred to the Tethys System underground as the building blocks of the data space within the Infinite Reality Sandbox

entries.name: Lollo Special Courier
entries.content: Lollo Logistics works in close partnership with the Black Shores. Following strict confidentiality protocols, couriers with special access are dispatched to the Black Shores as Consultants. They oversee imports and exports, ensuring a steady supply of resources for the Black Shores.

entries.name: Stargate
entries.content: [The] Stargate is a gateway hidden beneath the central waters of the Black Shores archipelago, where data surges endlessly downward like a torrent. Descend through the Stargate, and when gravity reverses its hold, Tethys’ Deep shall reveal itself.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.content:
Overtime reverberations of dead people will eventually fuse into new tacet discords, only a few of the dead frequencies can maintain their sense of self and instead become phantoms / golden phantoms.

Golden phantoms are... Reverberations mixed with the frequencies left behind by people who've passed away. When someone dies, their Reverberations linger. Usually, they merge into the same cacophony of frequencies that spawns Tacet Discords. But sometimes, a trace of their final will remains, and the mist shapes this into phantoms. This lingering will helps the phantoms resist becoming Tacet Discords and instead guide the lost through the mist. If the mist clears, they'll vanish. If the mist lingers, their fate is sealed. It will only be a matter of time before they merge with other Reverberations and become Tacet Discords. Their final frequencies tend to cling to certain objects... like the Luceanite. Item collected by Roccia as proof that they once lived.

entries.name: Whisperin
entries.content:
Whisperin Tacet Discords have a Tacet Core that resemble a star.

"Broken star", "Frequency Energy aligns with the hearing range of normal people".

These Tacet Discords consume the frequencies of humanity to mimic their body shape.

entries.name: Howler
entries.content:
Howler Tacet Discords have cores that resemble a rose or flower. They often mimic organic beings, such as plants or animals.

These Tacet Discords consume the frequencies of flora and fauna to mimic wildlife.

entries.name: Tranquilite
entries.content:
Polygon Tacet Discords often mimic the "earth", rocks, gems or other inorganic materials.

Polygon Tacet Cores appear rigid and layered on their bodies.

entries.name: Staticoid
entries.content: These Tacet Discords attach themselves to man-made objects and are sometimes described as parasites of the objects they're attached to.

entries.name: The Second Resonance Awakening
entries.content:
The concept of the Second Resonance Awakening represents a monumental leap in Resonator theory and practice. First posited by the Court of Savantae researchers, it hypothesizes that a collision between two resonating frequencies—under specific conditions—can unlock an extraordinary surge in Resonance Ability. While the initial experiments with Chronosorters provided glimpses of this potential, their inherent fragility meant they were ultimately unsuitable to sustain such immense power.

At the heart of this phenomenon lies Sentinel Jué, a being whose Temporal Mandate has safeguarded Jinzhou from annihilation for centuries. Severely wounded upon its descent onto [Mt. Firmament](https://www.notion.so/14fef7f91e4b8061bd3af9b68de3a9b4?pvs=21), Jué’s power could no longer maintain the natural flow of time, instead rewinding or halting it to prevent widespread destruction. The deteriorating stability of Jué’s Temporal Mandate spurred researchers to create artificial Resonance Objects—Chronosorters—to replicate and amplify its abilities.

One experiment, involving the 931st Chronosorter, briefly achieved the restoration of time for 1.29 seconds before succumbing to resonance shock. This fleeting success affirmed the validity of the Second Resonance Awakening theory, but it also highlighted the risks: [overclocking](https://www.notion.so/b17654ed21264e0eaff030c878d5b464?pvs=21)—the intense strain on a Resonator or device pushing their abilities beyond their limits—was essential but perilous.

The theory's culmination came with Magistrate Jinhsi, Jué’s appointed Resonator. To restore time to Jinzhou, she needed to confront Jué in a direct clash of Resonance. This battle was not only a test of strength but a necessary step to trigger her Second Awakening.

Jinhsi’s decision to face Jué reflected her indomitable spirit and commitment to her people. By pushing herself to the brink of overclocking, she managed to inherit Jué’s Temporal Mandate. The process not only stabilized Mt. Firmament but also solidified her place as Jinzhou’s protector, capable of wielding Resonance on a scale rivaling the Sentinel itself.

While Jinhsi’s success was a beacon of hope, the Fractsidus, a shadowy organization with its own ambitions, viewed her Second Awakening as a template for their pursuits. It is thought that they are trying to engineer an artificial awakening process, bypassing the natural connection between Sentinel and Resonator and they believe they are on the brink of creating Resonators whose power could rival even Jué’s.

The Second Resonance Awakening marks both a breakthrough and a perilous frontier. For individuals like Jinhsi, it represents hope, sacrifice, and an unyielding resolve to protect her homeland. For the Fractsidus, it is a stepping stone to unimaginable power. As Jinzhou begins to heal, questions linger: Will the awakening process become a tool for salvation or a weapon for domination? And what role will Rover play as these threads of fate intertwine?

The awakening has begun, but its repercussions are far from over.

entries.name: Leviathan
entries.content: The sea depths threnodian residing somewhere in in Rinascita.

entries.name: Fleurdelys / Cartethyia
entries.content:
Cartethyia is a supposedly deceased individual.

Throughout Rinascita, she is revered as Fleurdelys, the "Blessed Maiden," and in some accounts, "The Martyred Maiden." As a key figure in the region’s history, she holds profound influence, with her connections to the Sentinel Imperator, the Threnodian Leviathan, and the Dark Tide.

Cartethyia is known best by her holy name, Fleurdelys, the "Blessed Maiden". She is said to have once lived in Whisperwind Haven, though most stories about her have been lost to time.

According to a play still known by the Troupe of Fools, Cartethyia was originally a peasant girl who snuck past guards during a Sentinel's Gratitude Rite in Egla Town. She had gotten intoxicated after consuming the sacramental wine and proceeded to turn the solemn ceremony into a wild parade. The Pilgrim's Sail had not existed yet, so the Order of the Deep instead placed her in confinement for three days, during which she used her prison walls as a canvas.

Despite this, she was chosen to become the Blessed Maiden, and led Ragunna for a time, during which she promoted grand celebrations during the Carnevale. However, twenty years prior to the Main Quest, she had supposedly martyred herself to stop the second Dark Tide from destroying Ragunna.

According to Fenrico, the current Primus of the Order, Cartethyia was never the Blessed Maiden, and had deceived everyone. He claims that she was actually was the Resonator of the Threnodian, designed to plunge the city into chaos.

Despite her supposed death, Rover is able to briefly make contact with her after claiming the Laurel at the end of the Carnevale, during Main Quest What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing in Chapter II: Act III - What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.

It was revealed during Main Quest The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier in Chapter II: Act IV that Cartethyia was created by Leviathan within Imperator's Return Pod to serve as Leviathan's Resonator. She defied Its will and aided Imperator in defeating the Threnodian. Imperator then accepted her as its chosen Resonator before passing away.

entries.name: Nightmare Variant
entries.content:
A special Tacet Discord that lurks in the intricate network of the Dreamscape Nodes. It gathers frequencies of a particular negative emotion emanating from across all of Ragunna.

Nightmare Variants or Nightmare Echoes are Echoes that have been born from a special Tacet Discord. They take their form from our knowledge of Echoes.

entries.name: Blazing Bone
entries.content:
Blazing Bone is a Resonator Ascension Material obtainable from Dragon of Dirge.

The bone of the giant dragon, burning with a haunting flame. The fire blazes from its marrow, bringing both a soul-shaking trial and destruction to those who dare intrude. This is its eternal duty, a rage that never fades, ignited by those who forced it into service.

entries.name: Capollo Montelli
entries.content: As the son of Francesco Montelli, he was to be the next head of the Montelli Family, until Carlotta's Companion Story If On a Rainy Night a Family, when he was caught betraying the family's ideals and conspiring with the Order of the Deep in an attempt to strengthen the family against the Fisalia Family, even going so far as killing a member of the family named Benett. He was ousted and to be punished for his actions.

entries.name: Cristoforo
entries.content:
Presenting himself as a playwright, Cristoforo is a mysterious figure who possesses a great knowledge of various subjects, such as Rinascita traditions and history.

Although revealed to be a member of the Fractsidus, his theatrical nature is genuine, almost a metaphor for his true work. Rather directly involve himself in his plans, he prefers to instead 'place the characters on their stage' and witness situations unfold.

Claiming to be a playwright visiting Ragunna in search of inspiration for his work, Cristoforo first appears in Through the Sea Thou Break, stopping Rover from intervening with the Pilgrim's Sail. With the explanation of working on scripts about the Pilgrim's Sail and the Blessed Maiden, he appears several times in Chapter II, providing some guidance and information to Rover.

During What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing, he is revealed to be a member of the Fractsidus, working with Phrolova, and is responsible for orchestrating events in Rinascita.

entries.name: Diggy Duggy
entries.content: An incorporeal Tacet Discord inhabiting the body of a sturdy, diligent plushie. He lives on trust and gratitude earned by his hardworking hands—frequencies he finds most delectable.

entries.name: Every Flavor Bell Crab
entries.content: The troupe's favorite seafood, Bell Crab, is the soul of this dish. Each Bell Crab finds its perfect shell, giving it a distinct flavor. Before every meal, the troupe members place a bet: What will the next crab taste like?

entries.name: Fenrico
entries.content:
Fenrico appears to be a tall and slim middle-aged man with slicked white hair and light blue eyes, he wears in his left face the piece of a golden-yellow realistic mask.

Fenrico wears a long white cloak with a golden-yellow collar with triangular dark brown stripes that holds a long navy blue cape printed with golden-yellow drawings. He also wears a round golden-yellow collar, his cloak is hold by a dark brown rope printed with golden-yellow drawings. As well a dark gray skirt, a blue bracelet in his right arm, a metallic halo in his back and white shoes with a dark gray sole and a golden-yellow stripe.

As the current Primus of the Order of the Deep and the self-proclaimed Resonator of Sentinel Imperator, he governs over Ragunna. After witnessing the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden twenty years ago, he has gone to great efforts to impose the ideal of Unity onto Ragunna.

entries.name: Francesco Montelli
entries.content: He is the current head of the Montelli Family.

entries.name: Fulmine
entries.content:
He is a resonator and the manager of the Wutherim Film Studio and a member of the Pioneer Association.

Fulmine's Forte is called Celluloid Chronicle, which he can use to turn events into film. With the help of his partner, C-MOSS he can show these captured moments.

entries.name: HF Polygon Core
entries.content: A robust polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The concentric layers spiral inward in dense steps. It's deduced the density of its pattern correlates with the complexity of the Tacet Discord's behavioral patterns.

entries.name: HF Tidal Residuum
entries.content: A robust formation resembling a sailing ship, occasionally found on certain Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legend say Tacet Discords with this Residuum can hear the distant echoes of the Dark Tide.

entries.name: Laurus Salad
entries.content: Freshly mixed with Viscum Berries and Laurus Sprouts, this salad is light, sweet, and healthy. Acolytes of the Order regard the Viscum Berry as the "holy nourishment of the wise." They chew the fruit alongside sacred texts, believing that doing so imprints the teachings upon the soul.

entries.name: LF Polygon Core
entries.content: A fractured polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. Cracks can be found on its frail spiral structure. Seems to be a simple power unit of a Tacet Discord.

entries.name: LF Tidal Residuum
entries.content: A friable formation resembling a stranded boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita. Legends say these once covered every shore as the Dark Tide receded.

entries.name: Mercurio
entries.content: He's an Echo who mans the counter for the Averado Bank branch in Bank Street.

entries.name: MF Polygon Core
entries.content: A common polygonal Tacet Core with an intricate, terraced pattern. The spiral structure is fairly complete. Seems to be an analog circuit recording the behavioral patterns of a Tacet Discord.

entries.name: MF Tidal Residuum
entries.content: A common formation resembling a storm-weathered boat, often found on Tacet Discords in Rinascita, which are said to be born of the Dark Tide and carry this Residuum since their formation.

entries.name: Monnaie
entries.content: The old currency issued by Averardo Bank, which is no longer in circulation in Ragunna. Nowdays, it is good for nothing but commemoration. Averardo Bank is working to recycle these antiques.

entries.name: Multi-Scoop Ice Cream
entries.content: With a makeshift mini ice cream maker, Roccia serves up simple ice cream that's both generous in portion and light on the pocket. It's become a beloved treat among the troupe, satisfying their cravings for sweets without straining their budget.

entries.name: Nyarla
entries.content:
She is the owner of Masked Reverie.

A Resonator with the Forte ability, Ombra Elusiva (Invisibility), which allows her to become invisible.

entries.name: Firecracker Jewelweed
entries.content: A vividly colored flower shaped like an unfurling firework. Give a Firecracker Jewelweed a gentle shake, and its swollen capsules will burst open... The seeds scatter in all directions, resembling the colorful burst of a firecracker.

entries.name: Sword Acorus
entries.content: A tall flower with a firm stem, crowned by delicate flowers. Sword Acoruses are often used by instructors to teach swordsmanship to young nobles, replacing real swords with these harmless blooms. The children, entranced by the beauty and fragrance, find their attention captured far more easily than by cold, menacing blades.

entries.name: Platinum Core
entries.content:
Platinum Core is a Resonator Ascension Material obtainable from Sentry Construct.

A finely crafted armor grants the Echo unstoppable strength, while a restless core hums quietly beneath its protective shell. Is it a mechanical component that powers the Echo, or a spirit trapped within its metal confines?

entries.name: Resonant Calcite
entries.content: A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy. The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.

entries.name: The Netherworld's Stare
entries.content:
The Netherworld's Stare is a Skill Upgrade Material obtainable from Hecate.

The joyful rhythm of her rondo taps on the gates of the netherworld, and with a single exchange of glances, death takes its first step. A gaze from the other side transforms into a full moon, filling her hollow right eye—thus, the still moon shifts, awakened by her stare.

entries.name: Brant
entries.content:
He is the captain of the Troupe of Fools. As captain of the Fool's Troupe, Brant exudes a carefree, easygoing charm, unbound by convention. Beneath his flamboyant persona lies a genuine heart, deeply devoted to his family and companions. His life is dedicated to securing a safe haven for the Troupe’s members.

Brant has a boundless passion and theatrical flair, embodying both the performer and the dreamer in equal measure. As the captain of Rinascita’s Troupe of Fools, he thrives in chaos, reveling in the unpredictable nature of both the stage and life itself. His charisma is effortless; larger than life yet never insincere. He is a free spirit who dances between the whimsical and the profound, unafraid to embrace the absurd yet always carrying a quiet depth beneath his exuberance.  

Brant’s romantic nature extends beyond love; he is enamored with the world itself, seeing beauty in every fleeting moment. He believes that life, like a performance, should be embraced fully: boldly, passionately, and without restraint. He slips effortlessly into roles, crafting illusions with his words and presence, yet when the curtain falls, he is remarkably genuine. His loyalty to his troupe and those he cares for is steadfast, and while he may jest and tease, his warmth is undeniable. Though he appears carefree, he is a man who carries his own burdens in silence, choosing to shoulder them with a smile rather than darken the spirits of those around him.

Brant is a young man of average height and build with short turquoise hair that has fuchsia streaks and fuchsia eyes. His Tacet mark is located on the inner area of his left pectoral.

Brant wears a colorful pirate outfit consisting of a baggy dark green shirt that splits down the middle in a black frilly outline with a bright red fiery pattern revealing his torso along with flaring up at the top into a large collar with a bright red and gold checker pattern. His shoulders are adorned in black and gold pauldrons with many layers beneath them including a light blue layer with a bright fuchsia pattern repeating 3 times. Under that is a white layer with golden anchor shaped pins on both his left and right with jewelry strung in between them along with being adorned with frilly white and pale blue sleeves adorn with golden patterning and engravings and various belts and extensions. He wears long black fingerless with red straps near the wrists that cover up his forearms along with a red and black cape. Brant also white trousers with a double crossed belt and black boots with golden laces.

entries.name: Phoebe
entries.content:
“I'm Phoebe, an acolyte of the Order. Praise the Sentinel. May They guide you to compassion and enlightenment.”

She is an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep. She is a young woman of quiet devotion. With a kind heart, she fulfills her duties with unwavering diligence. Her prayers, like the light she carries, offer comfort and peace to all.

A Given of Happiness: Phoebe's staff had been a gift from Sister Isabella at the orphanage. She had received it on the day she was named an Acolyte. The staff is adorned with a bird-like head that she carries wherever she goes. She uses it as a weapon in combat, but its purpose goes beyond that; with a gentle swing, phoebe would use it to knock humans and Echoes out of any negative emotions.

Please Calm Down!: Sometimes, even Phoebe must resort to certain special means to resolve conflicts.
"If you put that thing in my pizza again, I swear to the holy
Sentinel, I'm gonna kick your sorry butt!"
"Someone is raising a ruckus outside Margherita's. Again. And a Resonator no less. Quick, go get Acolyte Phoebe!"
"...I'm on it!"
Phoebe gripped her staff tight, trying to muster up courage. "You can do this," she reminded herself, recalling the teachings of the Codex. "Come on, Phoebe! You are already getting quite good at holding back the strength..."
"Please... calm down!"

Beloved Friends: In Phoebe's eyes, Echoes are divine envoys, but also beloved friends. She sees everything in a positive light and treats every Echo with love and care. This is how she's become the well-respected, trustworthy Acolyte that she is today.

Common Echoes, typically indistinguishable to most, are all unique individuals to Phoebe. She can easily distinguish them, earning her the affectionate title "a walking encyclopedia of Ragunnesi Echoes." She loves the Echoes, and the Echoes love her back, behaving like eager puppies around her.

Sometimes, while diligently performing her duties, she'll find herself trailed by a long line of Echoes, each patiently awaiting her attention. Of course, this playful procession only occurs when no senior members of the Order are observing.
She swiftly brought down her staff, and the golden bird on its tip took flight, its wings shimmering with ethereal light, casting a gentle glow over the stunned crowd. The two parties, who had been in a heated argument only a second ago, smiled amicably and shook hands.
As always, another conflict was resolved without anyone getting hurt.
"This staff," Sister Isabella said, gesturing to its bird-shaped
head, "is crafted in honor of the holy birds that once flew around the Sentinel Imperator. Their wings are said to have been blessed by the grace of the Sentinel.

They bring hope and peace where they land." Phoebe knew the world was no longer as turbulent as it once was, but as the Codex decreed: "Little drops fill the ocean." To Phoebe, the phrase was a reminder that even the smallest actions, whether good or bad, could ripple outward This belief drove her to always strive for peace and happiness in the lives of those around her.

Phoebe dedicated herself to peacefully resolving conflicts in Ragunna, no matter their size, and seemed to have a knack for appearing exactly where and when she was needed.

A Mini Carnevale: The Carnevale was over, and night had fallen on Ragunna.
Phoebe wandered alone through the deserted square. Colorful streamers and balloons still swayed in the breeze, oblivious to the party's end. She paused, picking up a golden streamer and tucking it into her book.

Suddenly, a Wingray materialized from the night sky, landing silently at her feet. Its fluffy tail curled around her legs playfully. "Come! The city sleeps. No one will see us."
A voice whispered in her mind. Before she knew it, the Wingray lifted her into the air, and both of them bathed in the soft moonlight. They soared above the sleeping city, arriving soon at Egla Town.

There, in the center of the square, a makeshift stage had been erected. Two patches of light, emanating from Livia and Tilly, pierced the darkness. They began to play music, a lively tune that filled the air. Beppe and Brenno, already dancing,
beckoned her to join.

Phoebe laughed, her worries forgotten. She danced with abandon, the moonlight casting long, dancing shadows. The Wingray returned, this time carrying a laurel wreath in its beak. Gently, it placed the wreath on her head.
This was her Carnevale, a magical celebration just for her.

entries.name: Zani
entries.content:
A spectro resonator.

She is a staff member of the Montelli Family's Averardo Bank in Ragunna. As a serious and reliable Montelli employee, Zani follows a strict routine and manages tasks with ease. For years, she has clocked in on time without fail, finding as much enjoyment in her well-ordered life as in her carefully planned moments of leisure.

entries.name: Phoebe Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Graceful Luminescence

Evaluation Basis: [Excerpt of Letter of Recommendation from the Order Orphanage]

The moment I saw the glowing Tacet Mark on her upper left thigh, I knew immediately that this was a blessing from Imperator.

...Her Resonance Ability allowed her to manifest light, refracting it into various forms of prisms. Even on the darkest nights, when the storm has snuffed out all other light, she fills every room with a soft, radiant glow. A light so comforting it conveys the very essence of hope in the darkest of times. As written in the Tenets of the Deep, such light must have always existed in her heart, a sign of her relentless devotion...

*This record has been transferred from the Orphanage to the Order of the Deep's archives.

We have reason to believe that Acolyte Initiate Phoebe's unparalleled Resonance ability stems from her unwavering faith in the Divinity.

This is demonstrated by the rapport between her and the Echoes, a connection that has reinforced the trust some of our faithful have in her. Her active involvement in charitable works has already earned her recognition, therefore we have voted unanimously to grant her the title of Acolyte after her novitiate.

However, some within the Order believe that her closeness with the Echoes violates the Order's doctrines. The blessings of the Divine Envoys are to be shared equitably, as the Sentinel's love for Their people is impartial and untainted by favoritism. Being too close to the Divine Envoys could lead to unforeseen risks. For this reason, we do not recommend her appointment to the Servitude Hall, and believe it would be most prudent to transfer her to the Ministry of Holy Rituals instead...

Overclock Diagnostic Report: [Order of the Deep - Ministry of Holy Rituals Records]

Resonator Phoebe's waveform graph displays elliptical fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern is stable, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results fall within the normal phase range.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Phoebe's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking.

Acolyte Phoebe has always strictly adhered to the teachings of "silence" and "self-restraint," making her stability unmatched among her peers. Observations show that Acolyte Phoebe's Resonance ability produces a stable frequency, strongly affecting Echoes and Remnant Creatures. Humans can also be affected to a certain degree, experiencing "healing" on a spiritual level. This makes her particularly adept in roles that require soothing and mediation.

*Latest Notes: A brief sawtooth fluctuation was detected in Acolyte Phoebe's regular waveform. No abnormalities have been noted at this time, but continued monitoring is advised, with increased attention if necessary.

entries.name: Luminous Hymn
entries.content:
A rectifier, It is a floating book with wings with severeal cards floating infront of it.

"The Sentinel's grace, how sweet thou art.
Our home was lost, but found at last.
With twigs between my beaks, I brave the waves.Bound by love, we're crowned with holy light."

entries.name: Frozen In Time
entries.content:
A locket Phoebe carries with her, repurposed from an old pocket watch. Inside is a family portrait. It was lost to the depths of the sea during a shipwreck, but thanks to the tireless search of her kind friends, it was eventually returned to her.
"In the fleeting waves of time... in the beautiful spray of the sea, and in the light, there are words I want to tell you, over and over again."

entries.name: "Envoy"
entries.content: A handcrafted souvenir from a land across the sea was the only item Phoebe kept when her family's possessions were sold off. In the bedtime stories she once believed would never end, there was a bird with blue wings, the envoy of the Divinity. It had the power to cross through storms and bring happiness to the little girl who endured loneliness each night as she drifted to sleep.

entries.name: A Vision Far Away
entries.content:
An old, faded edition of the Codex of the Deep, handbound by a loving and devout mother. A proper, dutiful Acolyte should be well-versed in the contents of the Codex, holding the Sentinel's guidance close to heart. Phoebe always adhered to the teachings in her heart, though, if truth be told, she preferred the color of the sky to that of the sea.
"The Codex says that suffering brings us closer to the Divinity. But I still hope for a peaceful and happy life for you, my child."

entries.name: Brant Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Flamebound Compass

Resonance Evaluation Report: [Troupe Medic Benir's Notes (Unnumbered)]
I still recall that night as if it were yesterday. My first real trial after joining the troupe. Storm clouds blanketed the sea, and rain pounded down in sheets while monstrous waves threatened to capsize our ship at any moment. We were tossed about like driftwood, the helmswoman lost in the chaos, the ship spinning through the tempest. I huddled in the cabin, trembling as fear seeped through me.

Then I saw him.

There, atop the mast, stood the captain. The Tacet Mark on his chest shone like St. Elmo's Fire, a beacon showing us the way.

"Steady now, my friends!" I heard his voice cut through the howling wind, "Follow my command! Hard to starboard!"

The crew rallied at once, the disarray falling away as they returned to their posts with newfound focus. I quickly jotted down in my notes: While I lack the tools to confirm it, I am certain of one thing—Captain Brant is a Natural Resonator. The flames he conjures can light our way, even in the darkest of seas!

Interestingly, I often catch Captain Brant spinning in the air during combat. Is it a trick to sharpen his sense of direction, or his secret to navigating the seas? I do hope someone finds the courage to ask him. I'm dying to know!

Overclock Diagnostic Report: [The Troupe of Fools "Revel in Freedom" Tour - Ragunna Stop Application]
...

Lead Performer: Brant

The subject's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern is regular, and no signs of abnormal fluctuations are observed. The test results fall within the normal phase range.

Resonant Criticality: High. This test subject displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking.

Records indicate no history of Overclocking.

...

Approval Verdict: Stable. The Troupe of Fools' application is approved. They will assume full responsibility for any unforeseen incidents during the performance.

Note from a certain captain: Mark my words, not a thing will go awry!

entries.name: The Initial Treasure
entries.content:
A meticulously preserved Ammonoid fossil. Little Brant once stood atop a table, proudly declaring to his father that he had found a treasure hidden among the books. His father took off his glasses for a closer look, recognizing it as the Ammonoid fossil tucked away at the bottom of the bookshelf. Seizing the moment, his father recounted an adventure about unearthing the past and seeking the truth.

That Ammonoid became Brant's first treasure and marked the beginning of his journey into a world of endless adventure.

entries.name: All the World's His Stage
entries.content:
A sculpture of stacked masks, each crafted for a different play and occasion.

On stage, he is the star, the center of all eyes. With each mask, he breathes life into the tale, captivating the audience with joy and wonder. But offstage, there is no need to conceal his true self.

In that moment, he is, at last, simply Brant.

entries.name: Testament to a Captain
entries.content:
A tricorn hat, embroidered with the emblem of the Troupe of Fools.

Brant still remembers the first performance he witnessed aboard the Fool's Sail. The captain, undeterred by the crashing waves, led his crew through the Stygian Fjords and placed a tricorn atop the head of the eager young boy. The captain, with a playful wink, called him, "Captain Brant."

Years later, Brant also remembers his own first performance. Standing high on the mast, he shouted commands to raise the sails and steer the ship clear of deadly whirlpools that threatened to swallow them whole. At that moment, one of the crew reverently placed the very same tricorn upon his head. Cheers erupted as the entire crew shouted in unison, "Captain Brant! Captain Brant!"

entries.name: Unflickering Valor
entries.content:
Unflickering Valor is a Sword weapon.

Blistering winds and crashing waves, the sea devours all.
Only a lonely boat lamp stands alight!
Onwards! Towards the edge of the world you shall sail!

entries.name: Ocean's Gift
entries.content:
Ocean's Gift is a Rectifier weapon.

To fishers, the sea is their field of harvest.
Harvest means hope.

entries.name: Riccioli Islands
entries.content:
Riccioli Islands is a Region located in Rinascita. A group of islands northwest of Ragunna, rich in various marine resources. Falling out of the governance of the Order of the Deep, these islands have preserved the customs from Rinascita's Age of a Thousand Islands era, setting them apart from the rest of Ragunna in lifestyle. However, rumor has it a great mystery lies hidden within this secluded paradise...

Drake Island: A small island covered in the ruins of Rinascita's ancient architecture. Long uninhabited, the island is now nothing but desolation. Among the broken walls and remnants, glimpses of Rinascita's former glory can still be seen.

Riccioli Port: Fishermen deliver their catches to this port, and most of the fishery trade from the Riccioli Islands to Ragunna passes through here.

The fishermen and echoes of the Riccioli Islands maintain a simple lifestyle. They believe that under the protection of Cetus the Tide Breaker, peace itself is happiness.

Plank: An octopus Echo responsible for managing the port’s docks. Fishermen sell their catches here, as well as repair and upgrade their boats.

Abyssal Star Lighthouse: The four ancient lighthouses of the Ricciolli Archipelago. According to legend, if all four lighthouses are lit, Cetus the tide breaker will answer the prayers of the islanders, guiding them to the ancient heritage of Rinascita, once discovered by the great navigator Riccioli.

Helmwheel Village: A small island located closer to the fishing grounds. Generations of fishermen have settled here, forming a village where Echoes and humans work together in harmony.

Serene Bay: A vast, circular bay known as Serene Bay, regarded as a sacred place by the residents of the Riccioli Archipelago because Cetus rests here.

It is said that those who enter without the whale’s approval will ultimately become its food.

Ryeas Ruins: A group of ruins within the Riccioli Archipelago, surrounded by storms year-round. The islands contain numerous ancient ruins, seemingly linked in some way to the civilization of Rinascita.

entries.name: Vault Underground
entries.content: Vault Underground is a Region located in Rinascita. Tucked beneath the Sea of Clouds lies a vast depository zone of the Averardo Vault. Each item moved to the Vault will be meticulously transported to its designated storage location, where it will be safeguarded with the utmost care and precision.

entries.name: Rage Against the Statue
entries.content:
An elite class being.

This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
A stone statue TD that embodies deconstruction and reconstruction. Though sluggish and clumsy, its punches are devastating.
It hurls rocks and other rock-mimic Tacet Discords as a means of attack.

entries.name: Hurriclaw
entries.content:
An elite class being.

This enemy has a higher RES against Aero DMG.
A ferocious bear-mimic TD with Tacetite spikes on its head, neck, and shoulders. Its swings strike like a hurricane.

entries.name: Aero Prism
entries.content:
An common class being.

This enemy has a higher RES against Aero DMG.
A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins. Its rocky body is filled with powerful air currents.
Although its combat capability is relatively weak, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.

entries.name: Golden Junrock
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
A rock-mimic TD with Fool's Gold on its back. It is often mistaken for unmined gold ore.
Golden Junrock tends to meticulously polish the Fool's Gold it bears, a lifetime pursuit to amplify its brilliance.

entries.name: Calcified Junrock
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has a higher RES to Glacio DMG.
A rock-mimic TD that carries Resonant Calcite. The Remnant Energy flowing inside shimmers with an ever-changing pearly glow.
When agitated, Calcified Junrock flashes a dazzling light from its calcified exterior.

entries.name: La Guardia
entries.content:
A common class being.

A sword-wielding Echo that resembles a silent and stern statue, tasked with protecting Ragunna City's peace and safety for the Order.

Under its watch, any suspicious individuals or Echoes shall be immediately arrested and brought to the Chamber of Discipline to ensure the city's security.

entries.name: Sagittario
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
A bow-wielding Echo that resembles a statue, tasked with monitoring Ragunna City and reporting the details back to the Order.
Under its watch, any suspicious individuals or Echoes shall be immediately arrested and brought to the Chamber of Discipline to ensure the city's security.

entries.name: Sacerdos
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has higher RES to Aero DMG.
A statue-like Echo that symbolizes mercy and compassion, always listening to Ragunnesi's prayers and praises to the Order.
Under its watch, any suspicious individuals or Echoes shall be immediately arrested and brought to the Chamber of Discipline to ensure the city's security.

entries.name: Aero Drake
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has a higher RES to Aero DMG.
A TD that mimics a drake cub, with gusts of wind swirling between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.
Though small in size, it is fiercely territorial, always ready to drive off invaders with its breath and claws.

entries.name: Electro Drake
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has a higher RES to Electro DMG.
A TD that mimics a drake cub, with sparks of thunder flashing between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.
Though small in size, it is fiercely territorial, always ready to drive off invaders with its breath and claws.

entries.name: Glacio Drake
entries.content:
A common class being.

This enemy has a higher RES to Glacio DMG.
A TD that mimics a drake cub, with ice and frost forming between its claws. Often found living in groups in the wilderness.
Though small in size, it is fiercely territorial, always ready to drive off invaders with its breath and claws.

entries.name: Capitaneus
entries.content:
An elite class being.

This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
It holds the authority to command other Echoes of the Order, carrying out the Order's will to eliminate any transgressors.
Just as the Order's authority is inviolable, so too is the power of the Echo.

entries.name: Reserved Terminals
entries.content:
Reserved Terminals, a cutting-edge advancement in the world of Echoes, have become a symbol of both innovation and controversy in Rinascita. Unlike the widely used Common Echoes, which are bound to the Genesis Nexus and are mostly confined to specific areas, Reserved Terminals are more versatile and can operate beyond the borders of the Genesis Nexus. Their development has been spearheaded by a select few, including the influential Montelli family, who recognized the need for these specialized devices as Ragunna's influence began to expand.

The Montelli family, long renowned for their pioneering spirit, were instrumental in introducing Reserved Terminals for personal use. Their vision of opening Ragunna to the wider world and facilitating safer travel beyond the control of the Order of the Deep led to the creation of these terminals. The Montellis sought to break the reliance on Common Echoes, which had shackled the ambitions of the people of Rinascita. Common Echoes, while powerful and vital for managing Tacet Discords, are not suited for long-distance travel due to their reliance on the Genesis Nexus.
